source_ref.title_or_campaign: 토스 미니앱 — 앱을 쓰는 새로운 방식 (Toss Mini-App super-app showcase)
source_ref.product: 토스 미니앱 (Toss Mini-App: in-app third-party service marketplace inside the Toss super-app)
source_ref.production_note: Motion-graphics + app-UI montage; BGM-only, caption-led, no voiceover. Closing fineprint '*토스 미니앱 서비스는 만 19세 이상부터 이용할 수 있어요.' Year inferred as a recent (2024-2025) Toss mini-app launch campaign from UI style and product framing; not asserted from an on-screen date.

target_demo: 10s-40s smartphone-first Koreans already using Toss; broad mass audience shown that a single finance app now also does mobility, real-estate, news, shopping, jobs and casual games
narrative_arc: Promise to proof to product-name resolution. It opens by claiming Toss can do hundreds of things (a kinetic title plus a slot-machine list of unexpected non-finance services), argues you need no extra installs because it is all in one Toss app, then floods the screen with real lifestyle imagery and a horizontal carousel of actual mini-app feature cards, escalates into a dense scrolling wall of service chips that pours into a single phone showing the mini-app store (everyday apps) and then a casual game, lands the thesis on a clean text card 앱을 쓰는 새로운 방식, and resolves on the product name 토스 미니앱 and the toss logo.
creative_device: slot-machine service list + accumulating montage of real mini-app cards that physically pour into one phone, framed as 'everyday apps to games, one app'

production_signature.signature_note: Entirely composited motion-graphics and app-UI: locked-off frame throughout with motion supplied by sliding/scrolling UI cards, a slot-machine vertical list, a converging photo collage, a horizontal feature-card carousel, a dense scrolling chip wall, a liquid-blue morph and 3D objects. metrics mean_abs_shift_x 1.23 with sign_flips_ratio 0.187 read as sliding-UI translation, not a handheld camera wiggle; edges do not oscillate left-right, so no wiggle_3d.

global_layout.layout_note: Several registers: centered single-line title/text cards (cut1 open, cut5, cut6 name) on a light grey field; a fixed left phrase 토스에서 할 수 있는 paired with a right slot-machine vertical service list (cut1); a centered value-prop lockup 설치할 필요 없이 [icon] 토스 앱 하나로 (cut1 end); free-floating photo-collage and chip-wall scatter (cut2, cut4); a left-to-right scrolling carousel of mini-app cards (cut3); and a centered phone flanked by left/right captions 일상 앱부터 / 게임까지 (cut4). Closes on a centered logo lockup.

recurring_motifs: 3D Toss app icon (white tile, blue split-bean mark)

copywriting.tagline_structure: noun_phrase_claim (a new way + to use apps)
copywriting.copy_strategy: Lead with surprise (a finance app doing 따릉이/뉴스/알바/게임), prove breadth by piling real service cards into one phone, then compress the whole idea into one claim 앱을 쓰는 새로운 방식 and brand it 토스 미니앱. Copy is entirely on-screen captions; there is no voiceover.

recreation_prompts.t2i_start_frame: A clean Korean fintech motion-graphics key frame in a 16:9 landscape, captured at the slot-machine list beat of an opening sequence, set on a flat, softly luminous light cool-grey studio field in pale #eef1f5 with no photographic texture, the faintest top-to-bottom gradient and a barely-there vignette so the corners sit a hair darker than the bright center. There is no human subject anywhere in frame; every element is typographic or app-UI graphics. On the left third, vertically centered, sits a fixed charcoal Korean phrase 토스에서 할 수 있는 set in a heavy rounded sans-serif in near-black #2b2d31, reading as a sentence stem waiting to be completed. To its right runs a single vertical column, a slot-machine style list of mini-app service rows, each row a small rounded-square colorful app-icon tile followed by a Korean label in the same rounded sans-serif. One row near the vertical middle is the active item: its icon tile is fully saturated and its label is bold and color-keyed (for this still, a blue news tile beside 실시간 뉴스 보기), while the rows above and below it are dimmed to a soft light grey, partly cropped at the top and bottom edges to imply continuous scrolling, with legible greyed labels including 인기 알바 찾기, 부동산 안전 거래, 따릉이 타기, 수영 기록하기, 용달 예약하기, 장학금 알림 받기 and 여행 코스 AI 추천, each with its own simple flat icon. The right column is generously spaced with comfortable line gaps, and the whole composition is asymmetric but balanced, the left stem anchoring while the right list scrolls. Wide empty margins surround everything; negative space does real work, giving the single highlighted service room to breathe and signalling a calm, confident brand. Lighting is rendered as perfectly even digital fill with uniform luminance across the pale field, no hot spots, no cast shadows behind the type, the cleanest possible screen-native surface, with only the faint app-icon tiles carrying a hint of soft plastic specular sheen. The lens read is flat and orthographic, a straight-on 50mm-equivalent view sitting exactly on the picture plane at eye level with no perspective distortion and no depth. The color strategy is brand-dominant and desaturated-with-pop: a near-neutral cool-grey background and charcoal type hold almost all the frame, the cobalt Toss-blue #1a56f0 keys only the single active service for emphasis, and small multi-hued icon tiles (a warm coral-orange #e8512f among them) provide tiny controlled jewels of color, the blue reading as roughly ten percent of the frame area. Textures are clean flat vector type on flat color, smooth glossy plastic on the rounded icon tiles, and a smooth matte field behind, with no grain, paper fiber or noise of any kind. The atmosphere is bright, clinical and uncluttered, with no haze, particles, smoke or glow except where the design intends it. The post and signature look is crisp anti-aliased 4K commercial app-marketing minimalism, even letter spacing, gentle rounding on every glyph and tile, and a brand-forward, trustworthy finish. Style anchor: Korean fintech UI motion-graphics, a slot-machine service-list interstitial that lists everyday mini-app services beside a fixed sentence stem, hi-key light-grey studio, absolutely no people; this still is one held beat of an animated vertical scroll in which services cycle through the highlighted slot, immediately before the layout collapses into a centered value-prop lockup.

The cards are square-ish rectangles with generous corner radii and the very softest drop shadow lifting them off the pale ground, each filled with a muted, slightly desaturated lifestyle photograph. A large central card shows a cyclist seen from behind crossing a bridge with a hazy city skyline behind, captured with motion blur in the background to imply speed; upper-left a card shows a man running on a red running track in dark athletic kit, also motion-blurred; lower-left a card shows an iced coffee glass on a sunlit table with leaf shadows falling across it; below that a small card shows a wooden chess board mid-game on a red-and-cream checkered surface; upper-right a small card shows a cluster of tall white apartment towers against a pale sky; mid-right a card shows a green-toned train-cabin window framing a passing mountain-and-rail landscape; lower-right a larger card shows a white paper shopping bag with a red handle resting against a wall in raking light. The cards are distributed across the frame with airy gaps of pale grey between them, sitting at slightly different scales so the eye reads depth without any single card dominating, and the overall arrangement feels like a constellation of everyday moments about to gather together. There is no on-screen text and no brand mark anywhere in this still; human figures appear only small and incidental inside the running and cycling photos, never as a foreground subject. Lighting in the graphic layer is rendered as perfectly even digital fill with uniform luminance across the pale background and only the softest contact shadows under each card; the daylight inside each photograph is baked into the image, bright open sky on the cyclist and apartments, warm low sun on the coffee and shopping bag, so the cards carry their own internal light while the canvas stays flat and screen-native. The lens read for the graphic plane is flat and orthographic, straight-on at eye level with no perspective distortion, the cards lying on the picture plane. The color strategy is muted and analogous: the pale neutral field dominates, cool dusty blues from the skies and the train card balance warm caramel and terracotta tones from the coffee and track, and nothing is highly saturated, giving a calm editorial feel with the cool sky tone reading as roughly twenty percent of the frame. Textures are photographic print inside the cards, fabric, asphalt, glass, wood, paper, against a smooth matte vector field, with no grain or noise added on top. The atmosphere is airy, clean and unhurried, no overlay haze, smoke or particles, just floating imagery on light grey. The post and signature look is crisp 4K commercial motion-graphics compositing with soft rounded card masks, gentle ambient shadows and an uncluttered editorial finish. Style anchor: Korean fintech UI motion-graphics, a drifting lifestyle photo-collage interstitial that stands in for the hundreds of everyday things a super-app covers, hi-key light-grey studio, no foreground people; this still is an early spread state of an animated convergence in which the cards drift and scale toward a central cluster.

recreation_prompts.t2i_start_frame: A high-energy Korean fintech motion-graphics key frame in a 16:9 landscape, captured at the dense accumulation beat, set on a flat light cool-grey field in pale #eef1f5 that is almost entirely covered by a scrolling wall of mini-app service chips and floating glossy 3D objects. There is no human anywhere; the subjects are UI chips and stylised 3D props. Across the frame, dozens of horizontal rounded pill chips drift at slightly different speeds: many are plain solid-color capsules (cobalt blue, soft sky-blue, coral orange, violet, mint, pale grey, near-white) reading as a colorful field of placeholders, while several are fully detailed service chips, each a white pill with a small colorful round app icon on the left and two lines of Korean text, a bold name and a light-grey one-line description. Legible detailed chips in this still include 팜픽 영양제 제대로 고르기 with a mint pill-bottle icon, 마이클 내 차 엔진오일 가격 보기 with a blue car-care icon, 디스팟 가격 낮추는 할인코드 찾기 with a blue discount-ticket icon, 슬라이스 가장 빠른 디지털 명함 with a black mark, and 머지푸르트 황금수박 만들기 with a watermelon icon. Interspersed among the chips float oversized glossy 3D objects rendered in soft studio plastic: a fat white chat speech-bubble with three dots, a shiny red apple with a green leaf, a white-and-grey game controller, and a chunky green cube, each catching a soft top highlight and casting a faint soft shadow, giving the flat chip field bursts of dimensional pop. The arrangement is deliberately busy and abundant, pills and objects packed across the whole frame with only slivers of pale grey showing between them, the eye unable to land on any single item, the visual argument being that there are hundreds of these. Lighting is even digital fill across the field with the 3D objects lit by a soft broad frontal key at a neutral temperature and a strong fill, carrying gentle specular highlights and soft contact shadows, while the flat chips stay screen-native and shadowless except for thin card shadows. The lens read is flat and orthographic, straight-on at eye level with no perspective distortion, everything on the picture plane. The color strategy is polychrome-heading-to-brand: at this beat the frame is intentionally multi-hued and saturated to read as variety and abundance, with cobalt Toss-blue #1a56f0 the most frequent capsule color so the brand still anchors the chaos, warm coral-orange #ff7a59 and mint-green #34c759 chips adding heat and freshness, the blue family reading as roughly twenty percent of the busy frame; the design implies that this entire swarm will shortly collapse into a single blue liquid and a clean white phone. Textures are flat vector UI on the chips and smooth glossy plastic and clear surfaces on the 3D objects, over a smooth matte field, with crisp anti-aliased type and no grain. The atmosphere is lively and dense but still clean, no haze or smoke, the energy coming from quantity and color rather than texture. The post and signature look is crisp 4K commercial motion-graphics with rounded masks, gentle ambient occlusion under the 3D objects and a bright, playful, brand-forward finish. For this multi-element beat, decompose the frame into a tiled wall of discrete service-chip panels plus a few foreground 3D-object focal panels, all sharing one background, so it reads as a single scrolling inventory of mini-app services. Style anchor: Korean fintech UI motion-graphics, a dense accumulating wall of mini-app service chips with playful 3D props, hi-key light-grey studio, no people; this still is the peak-density state just before the swarm sweeps into a blue liquid morph and pours into one centered smartphone.

recreation_prompts.t2i_start_frame: A minimal, declarative full-screen typographic statement card in a 16:9 landscape, built around a single centered line of Korean type on a flat, softly luminous light cool-grey field in pale #eef1f5 with no texture, no gradient to speak of and no vignette, the emptiness doing the emotional work. Centered both horizontally and a touch above the true vertical middle sits one line reading 앱을 쓰는 새로운 방식 set in a heavy rounded Korean sans-serif in near-black charcoal #2b2d31, the glyphs evenly tracked and confidently weighted so the claim reads instantly and feels resolved. There is nothing else in the frame: no logo, no icon, no UI, no imagery, no people, no decorative shapes, only the single charcoal line and a wide breathing field of pale neutral above, below and to either side of it. Lighting is rendered as perfectly even digital fill with absolutely uniform luminance across the entire grey plane, no hot spots, no falloff toward the corners and no cast shadow behind the letters, keeping the surface clean and screen-native. The lens read is a straight-on flat composition with no perspective and no depth, the type sitting exactly on the picture plane at eye level. The color strategy is deliberately monochrome and neutral: one near-neutral light-grey background plus one charcoal for the text, a pure luminance contrast that is instantly legible and intentionally un-branded at this beat so the idea, not the color, lands; the charcoal type reads as roughly ten percent of the frame area. Texture is none in any photographic sense, smooth flat vector type on smooth flat color, the cleanest possible digital surface, no grain, no paper, no noise. Atmosphere is none: this is a graphic interstitial, not a photographic scene, so there is no haze, glow, dust or particle of any kind. The post and signature look is crisp, anti-aliased modern app-marketing minimalism, the kind of calm one-line thesis card that punctuates a Korean fintech montage right after its busiest beat to let the audience exhale and read the point. The single line is optically centered rather than mathematically centered, nudged a hair above the middle so the slightly larger empty lower half feels intentional and balanced, and the weight of the glyphs is heavy enough to hold presence on the pale field without shouting. The spacing across 앱을, 쓰는, 새로운 and 방식 gives the line a measured, confident cadence, as if the whole film has been compressed into one quiet claim. The composition is the simplest kind of all: a single horizontal line of text floating in a large rectangle of even pale grey, with no competing focal point, no secondary line, no kicker and no graphic furniture, the entire frame organised around the one centered claim and the calm field around it. The negative space is the real subject here, easily four-fifths of the frame is empty pale neutral, and that emptiness reads as confidence and editorial restraint rather than as a missing element, the kind of deliberate breath a Korean fintech edit takes so the audience can land on the idea before the brand name arrives. There is a quiet, almost silent quality to the composition, the held final-thought beat that follows the busiest montage in the film and precedes the product-name reveal, the charcoal glyphs sitting with even weight and even tracking so nothing about the line feels rushed or decorative. Nothing animates in this still; it is a deliberate held statement between a dense product montage that precedes it and the brand-name reveal that follows. Style anchor: Korean fintech UI motion-graphics, a calm centered one-line thesis card in charcoal on light grey, total simplicity, no imagery and no people; this still is the held state of the statement card just before its words begin shifting color and morphing toward the product-name reveal.

recreation_prompts.t2i_start_frame: A minimal Korean fintech brand-reveal key frame in a 16:9 landscape, captured at the 3D-object connector beat just before the product-name card, set on a flat, soft, very light off-white field in pale #eceef1 with the faintest cool tint and an extremely subtle center bias, calm and premium and uncluttered. There is no human; the subjects are glossy 3D category objects and brand typography. Across the horizontal midline sit two small clusters of oversized glossy 3D objects rendered in soft studio plastic and glass, separated by a thin glowing horizontal blue light-beam that runs through the empty center of the frame like a connective thread. On the left cluster: a golden money bag marked with a Korean won symbol, a chunky dark-grey toy car, and a small house with a vivid blue roof and white walls, reading as finance, mobility and real-estate. On the right cluster: a shiny red apple with a green leaf, a white-and-grey game controller, and a faceted deep-blue crystal diamond, reading as lifestyle, play and rewards. Each object catches a soft top-left highlight and casts a faint soft contact shadow on the pale field, and the slim blue beam between the two clusters carries a gentle bloom, implying that all these different worlds are linked by one connecting layer. The composition is symmetrical and generously spaced, the two object clusters balanced left and right with a wide calm gap of pale neutral and the glowing line bridging them, plenty of empty field above and below so the arrangement feels confident and premium rather than crowded. Lighting is rendered as even digital fill across the off-white field with the 3D objects lit by a soft broad frontal key at a neutral temperature and strong fill, gentle specular highlights and soft contact shadows grounding them, plus the localized soft glow along the blue beam; the surface stays clean and screen-native with no hot spots elsewhere. The lens read is flat and orthographic, straight-on at eye level with no perspective distortion, the objects and beam sitting on the picture plane. The color strategy is brand-dominant with controlled warm accents: the pale neutral field holds most of the frame, cobalt Toss-blue #1a56f0 owns the connecting beam and the blue house roof and diamond so the brand color threads the composition, a warm coral-orange #ff7a59 and a crimson-red #e23b54 appear only as small jewels on the apple and the money bag, and the blue reads as roughly ten percent of the frame; the design implies the whole palette is about to resolve to brand blue for the name and logo. Textures are smooth glossy plastic on the bag, car, house and controller, faceted crystal glass on the diamond, and crisp flat vector type elsewhere, all over a smooth matte field with no grain. The atmosphere is calm, clean and premium, no haze, smoke or particles, just glossy objects, a glowing line and pale space. The post and signature look is crisp 4K commercial motion-graphics with gentle ambient occlusion under each object, a soft beam bloom and a restrained brand-forward finish. Style anchor: Korean fintech UI motion-graphics, a 3D category-object connector beat that bridges finance, life and play with a single glowing line on light off-white, total simplicity, no people; this still is the held state just before the objects give way to a centered multi-color product-name card 토스 미니앱 and then a centered toss logo lockup with a small bottom fineprint about an age requirement.

inferred_creative_thinking.insight: People think of Toss as just a finance/banking app and have no idea it now hosts hundreds of unrelated everyday services and games, so the job is to expand the mental category of the brand.
inferred_creative_thinking.persona: An existing Toss user who opens it only to send money or check banking, unaware they could also rent a bike, book a train, read news, find a part-time job or play a casual game without installing anything new.
inferred_creative_thinking.moment: The beat where dozens of named service chips and lifestyle photos physically pour into one phone, making 'it's all already in here' feel literal rather than claimed.
inferred_creative_thinking.product_role: Toss positions its mini-app marketplace as a new operating layer — use any of these services inside the one Toss app, no separate downloads, no separate logins.
inferred_creative_thinking.punchline: Everyday apps to games, all without installing anything: that's the Toss mini-app, a new way to use apps.
inferred_creative_thinking.differentiator: Breadth and zero-install convenience of a super-app, dramatized by a slot-machine list and an accumulating card montage instead of a feature list.
inferred_creative_thinking.brand_fit_one_liner: Toss turns 'just a finance app' into 'the one app that quietly does everything', clean and playful.

inferred_brief: Reposition Toss from a finance app to a super-app by showcasing the breadth of its no-install mini-app marketplace — from everyday life services to casual games — and brand the experience as 토스 미니앱, 앱을 쓰는 새로운 방식.
analyst_notes: 33.5s Toss 미니앱 super-app showcase, BGM-only and caption-led (no voiceover; whisper found 0 speech segments). Pure motion-graphics + app-UI montage, locked-off with sliding/scrolling UI motion (no camera wiggle despite mean_abs_shift_x 1.23 — that is UI translation). 6 cuts: (1) hook title 토스에서 할 수 있는 수백 가지 일들 + slot-machine service list + value-prop 설치할 필요 없이 토스 앱 하나로; (2) converging photo collage of lifestyle imagery; (3) horizontal carousel of real mini-app feature cards (bike rental, swim tracker, Japanese learning, KTX/flight tickets, game, AI image); (4) WOW beat — dense scrolling chip wall of named services + floating 3D objects that morph through a blue liquid and pour into one phone showing the mini-app store (일상 앱부터) then a casual game (게임까지); (5) hard-cut thesis card 앱을 쓰는 새로운 방식 (this is the 27.62s cut the metrics hard-flagged); (6) kinetic color-typo + 3D-object connector montage to the product-name reveal 토스 미니앱 and the centered toss logo with fineprint 만 19세 이상. Service/card copy captured verbatim. Brand logo rendered generically in recreation prompts.
